# /llms.txt
# JobXApply
> One profile. Every resume, ATS score check, and job-application autofill.

JobXApply is a resume builder, ATS resume score checker, and browser extension that auto-fills job applications across major portals (Naukri, LinkedIn, Indeed, and others) from a single user profile.

## Key facts
- Founded: 2026
- Primary market: students and jobseekers in India
- Core tools: Resume Builder, ATS Score Checker, Auto-Fill Extension, Application Tracker
- Pricing: free tier available; paid Pro tier is a time-boxed pass, not a recurring subscription

## Pages
- /: Product overview and waitlist
- /ats-checker: How ATS scoring works, and the tool itself
- /extension-setup: How the auto-fill browser extension works
